title: The Bird in the Garden
summary: A curious bird explores a garden and discovers treasures of worms and berries.

pages.text: A young bird woke up in her nest very early one morning.
pages.scene: Small bird stretching wings in a cozy nest in a tree

pages.text: She wanted to search for food all around the large garden.
pages.scene: Bird perched on branch, looking down at a garden below

pages.text: The bird flew down to the dark earth to look for worms.
pages.scene: Bird landing gracefully on brown garden soil

pages.text: She turned over leaves and dirt with her little beak.
pages.scene: Bird pecking and digging carefully in the soil

pages.text: She found three fat worms under the bark.
pages.scene: Bird discovering worms beneath a piece of wood

pages.text: Her tummy felt happy and full of joy after that.
pages.scene: Bird looking satisfied, feathers fluffy and content

pages.text: The bird went further into the garden to search more.
pages.scene: Bird hopping along garden path between flowers

pages.text: She saw a tall thorn bush with berries on each limb.
pages.scene: Thorny bush covered with bright red berries

pages.text: The berries were purple, red, and sweet to her taste.
pages.scene: Bird pecking at berries, clearly enjoying them

pages.text: The bird knew the garden was her special world.
pages.scene: Bird standing proudly surveying the entire garden

pages.text: She would return each morning to work and search.
pages.scene: Bird flying back toward her nest at sunset

pages.text: Her heart was filled with hope and love for nature.
pages.scene: Bird in nest at twilight, watching stars appear
Bird nestled in nest, peaceful and content
